name: 全速出击
description: 自身及周围5×5范围内所有友方棋子移速+1。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var allies = battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && arePlayersAllied(battle, piece.ownerPlayerId, source.ownerPlayerId) && Math.abs(piece.x - source.x) <= 2 && Math.abs(piece.y - source.y) <= 2; }); allies.forEach(function(ally) { ally.moveRange = Number(ally.moveRange || 0) + 1; }); return { success: true, message: source.name + '发动全速出击，使' + allies.length + '个友方棋子移速+1' }; }
